decision: Require the shared contract gate inside every registered StoryPackage and matching-layer entry point.
source: User required the harness to always enforce contracts and made enforcement mandatory.
scope: StoryPackage adaptation, semantic splitting, Story/Data handoffs, typed data assignment, candidate retrieval, matching, route planning, evaluation and harness execution.
reason: A separate audit can report a violation after processing but cannot prevent a direct module call from bypassing the contracts.
sections: ### Mandatory contract enforcement at every entry point

decision: Allow review-only diagnostic work only after contract validation while reserving production for a completely passing current harness.
source: Existing review-only workflow and the user's mandatory enforcement requirement.
scope: All registered matching entry points and saved harness receipts.
reason: This preserves useful calibration without allowing a missing generality or release receipt to become production authorization.
sections: ### Mandatory contract enforcement at every entry point

decision: Reject missing, unregistered or stale contract enforcement rather than silently rebinding evidence.
scope: Entrypoint registry, hash-bound receipts, harness validation and legacy frozen evaluation inputs.
reason: Automatic rebinding would turn changed inputs into apparently approved evidence and defeat the purpose of mandatory contracts.
